firstPlayerRule: The youngest player becomes the First Player and takes the First Player token.
houseFallback: If this criterion does not suit your group, agree to choose randomly. This is a house rule.
clarifications: At the end of each round, the First Player token passes clockwise to the next player.
The First Player draws Event cards (from round 2), handles morale, and alone fights any combat an Event demands.

SHA-256: 56b2d6b149e98f1e4ebcb58401c37c951f506404197d20a243fbc9a579e06c3c. Read the extracted text of PDF pages 5, 8, 9, 23, 26 and 37. Page 5, setup step 17: ‘The youngest player becomes the First Player and receives the First Player token.’ Pages 8–9: the First Player draws Event cards from round 2 and checks morale. Page 23: at the end of the round, pass the First Player token clockwise. Page 26: 2-player and solo variants add Friday (and the Dog in solo) without changing the start. Page 37 credits designer Ignacy Trzewiczek, game manual by Simon Reitenbach, publisher Portal Games, identifying the revised English rulebook of Robinson Crusoe: Adventures on the Cursed Island (BGG 121921). Owner authorized assistant review on 2026-09-25. Editorial review 2026-09-25: Rechecked the source pages, opening instruction, game identity, and edition.
